evidence: Archived news leading up to October 25, 2024, reflects strongly positive institutional and sentiment catalysts. Most notably, an SEC filing revealed Microsoft included an assessment on investing in Bitcoin on its shareholder meeting ballot, providing fresh institutional momentum. Furthermore, BlackRock's IBIT reported strong spot ETF inflows supporting a rebound above $67K, and Tesla confirmed it retained its entire Bitcoin treasury, clearing market concerns around recent wallet transfers. ETH/BTC also sank to three-year lows, confirming relative strength and market dominance in Bitcoin. These combined factors indicate a supportive short-term backdrop tilted toward upside.
limitations: Duplicate reporting on Cardano BitcoinOS integration between Coinscreed and CoinTelegraph was clustered as a single ecosystem signal.
News sentiment cannot fully account for short-term weekend liquidity variations or broader macroeconomic risk shocks.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
